__INTRO__ English words, their meanings, and the __LANG_NAME__ word which-dialect puts first. Where the first word is wrong or stiff, I drafted the natural everyday choice (“Suggested”, in the box). Use suggestion moves it to the top; today’s words stay after it, as the “Order” line shows. To change the order, drag the words in that line, or use their ‹ › buttons; ✕ takes a word out (a removed current word won’t be shown for this meaning; ↺ brings it back). To reorder only today’s words, press Keep current, then rearrange them. Keep current rejects it and leaves the “Current” word, what which-dialect shows today. To use your own words, type them in the box (best first, separated by “/”; a region in brackets, e.g. __REGION_EXAMPLE__), then press Use suggestion. Put the general word first: a word tagged for a region goes first only for learners of that region, and learners of general __LANG_NAME__ get the words in the order listed. Your choices save as you go.

Your choices can’t be saved in this view, so they’ll only last until you close the page. Open it on claude.ai while signed in to save them.
